subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add opt-in all-message Space ingestion through user OAuth or Google Workspace Events, and what credential/scope/config contract should be accepted?
rationale: The remaining request changes Google Chat data visibility, OAuth or event-subscription credentials, token/subscription lifecycle, and operator consent; source review can prove the gap but cannot choose that security boundary.

options.title: Approve Plugin-Owned OAuth/Events Design
options.body: Define a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub contract, keep service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion behind explicit operator configuration.

options.title: Keep Mention-Only Webhooks
options.body: Keep the bundled Google Chat plugin limited to service-account webhook delivery and close or narrow all-message ingestion as out of scope while thread delivery is handled separately.

options.title: Defer To Shared Workspace Auth
options.body: Hold this until a broader Google Workspace consent, token, event-subscription, and admin-approval model is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve Plugin-Owned OAuth/Events Design
recommendation.body: Define a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub contract, keep service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion behind explicit operator configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history and prior review context across Google Chat auth, thread delivery, and plugin-boundary decisions.
